lede: No story crossed more than one feed today, so the loudest signal is a lone one: Patrick Stewart pulled 450,119 Wikipedia reads, half again the next article on the list, with nothing in the other sixteen feeds to explain the surge. The rest of the web ran along its usual tracks. On GitHub, the day's top trending repo was claude-mem, a tool that gives AI coding agents persistent memory across sessions, with 1,723 new stars; Hacker News spent its attention on HackerTube, Andrej Karpathy's toy that builds a YouTube feed only from videos the HN crowd has recommended. Underneath it all, a magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck 58 km off Shima, Japan, the largest of 25 logged in 24 hours, from a deep 352 km focus that kept it quiet at the surface.
